description: This dataset records results from a laboratory experiment investigating jellyfish pulsation rates under various ecological conditions. It contains twenty observations across eleven distinct experimental tanks, categorized by study type and specific treatments such as control, dissolved organic carbon, zooplankton, and phytoplankton. The data tracks the duration of exposure in days and measures the resulting pulsation frequency of X. umbellata. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze how different environmental factors and time durations influence the biological behavior and metabolic activity of jellyfish in controlled settings.
